examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Дорогие друзья, к сожалению, мне пора в аэропорт.
examples.trans: Dear friends, unfortunately it's time for me to go to the airport.
We are driving to the airport.

examples.text: Мне маму в аэропорту надо встретить.
examples.trans: I need to meet my mum at the airport.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.en: line, branch (of a railway or metro)

examples.trans: At the same time I'll trim the branches in the yard.
A bird is sitting on a branch.

examples.text: Пакет с ветки снимешь — и отдам.
examples.trans: Take the bag off the branch and I'll give it to you.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job

examples.text: Вот и возьмите на работу Галилея.
Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.en: to get to, reach, make it (somewhere)

examples.text: С приездом вас, как вы сегодня добрались?
examples.trans: Welcome! How was your journey today?

examples.text: Добралась нормально, спасибо большое, мои хорошие.
examples.trans: I got here fine, thank you so much, my dears.
You'll get to the airport along the branch line.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.
examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?
I love our town very much.
You're in love with another man's wife!

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.
Don't laugh. Read me the number.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.note: carries address registration and marriage stamps in Russia

examples.trans: You need a stamp in the passport.
Got that? You need a stamp in the passport.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

позаботиться.gloss: to take care of, look after

meanings.en: to look after, take care of

examples.trans: Who else will take care of me?

examples.text: Она всегда готова позаботиться о друзьях.
examples.trans: She is always ready to look after her friends.

покинуть.gloss: to leave, to vacate, to abandon

meanings.note: formal; + accusative of place or person

examples.trans: What is the matter? Leave the operating room!

meanings.note: the person helped is in the dative: 'помогать маме' = to help mum

examples.text: Так, операцию продолжаем. Михаил Михайлович, помогайте Лаврову.
examples.trans: Right, the operation goes on. Mikhail Mikhailovich, give Lavrov your help.

попрощаться.gloss: to say goodbye, to bid farewell

examples.text: Я пришёл сюда навсегда попрощаться с тобой.
examples.trans: I came here to say goodbye to you forever.

examples.text: Пойдём, я быстро с ней попрощаюсь.
examples.trans: Let us go, I will quickly say goodbye to her.

examples.text: Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: That's why I'm running for a second term.
I'm tired, so I'm at home.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
The restaurant was only my cover.
Was that also your cover story?

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: сбежать из-под венца = to run away from the altar

examples.text: Да, он сбежал, чтобы спасти моего ребёнка.
examples.trans: Yes, he ran away to save my child.
Your daughter ran away from the altar.

examples.text: Ты думал, что легко сбежишь отсюда?
examples.trans: Did you think you'd escape from here easily?

meanings.note: сбрить усы = to shave off one's mustache

examples.text: А я их сегодня утром сбрил.
examples.trans: I shaved them off this morning.

examples.text: Ты зачем свои усы сегодня сбрил?
examples.trans: Why did you shave off your mustache today?
And don't forget to shave off the mustache.
We'll definitely have a big wedding!

examples.text: Макс, зачем ты соврал про нашу будущую свадьбу?
examples.trans: Max, why did you lie about our future wedding?
Then a wedding, and then kids!

examples.text: Я вижу, что ты связан с едой.
examples.trans: I can see you're connected with food.

examples.text: Кукловод и марионетка всегда связаны одной нитью.
examples.trans: The puppeteer and the puppet are always tied by a single thread.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

examples.text: Павел Юрьевич, это срочно! Я должна вам сказать.
examples.trans: Pavel Yuryevich, this is urgent! I must tell you.
The whole country is laughing at you!

examples.text: Над тобой вся страна смеётся! Все видели, как ты из окна летел.
examples.trans: The whole country is laughing at you! Everyone saw you fly out the window.

meanings.note: там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

examples.text: Мы же здесь выросли. И о людях тоже надо думать.
examples.trans: After all, we grew up here. And you have to think about people too.

examples.text: Лёва, ты с усами так поумнел!
examples.trans: Lyova, you look so much smarter with a moustache!

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
